lines.d62a1b0d: Bao the panda, from Ming China. Calm, kind, and very patient.
lines.d6ca5114: This is you! Here you can see your level, your games, and your badges.
lines.d713036f: Golden caramel and fresh cream, with crowns and manes in gold leaf. It's soft, warm and sweet, just like its name. A treat from the Cocoa Harvest.
lines.d8137028: A rooftop above Times Square, in a sea of neon lights. The city never sleeps, and neither does this game!
lines.d8d3b3d1: Pawns like to stick together. Let's see which ones get lonely.
lines.d91bf750: Let's find a perfect home for your knight, where nobody can chase it.
lines.d9baf3eb: Look at it sparkle! Crystal Jewels are cut like the gems in a jeweller's window, clear crystal against jet black. Each kind of piece wears its own coloured jewel, so you can spot it at a glance.
lines.d9f6e755: A shiny bronze ring, for players who are getting good.
lines.da2207b2: Red lacquer and gold, facing the great hall of the Forbidden City. A study fit for an emperor.
lines.da936c69: A meadow above the forest, facing a white castle with blue towers. Just like a fairy tale.
lines.dbaf9c0d: A golden bishop on violet enamel. Sneaky, smart, and always diagonal.
lines.dbb6b3f9: Marco the winged lion, the proud guardian of Venice.
lines.dcf6b819: Next to the king stands the Mantri, his wise counsellor. He takes one small step, on a slant. Much later, he grew into the queen!
lines.dd2dbdc8: A ruby lacquer clock with soft pink numbers. Pretty, but it still keeps time.
lines.dffa8023: Mysore Palace on a festival night, lit up by thousands of lamps. It's like playing inside a celebration.
lines.e00b5933: Petals whirl up from every capture and bloom open. So pretty!
lines.e0535db1: A chocolate shop on the Grand-Place of Brussels, with golden guild houses outside. Mmm, smell that cocoa!
lines.e0839dc2: This is your collection! Tap anything to see it up close, and I will tell you all about it. Then tap Equip, to put it on your table.
lines.e0b18e4a: Elves on one side, orcs on the other, and you right in the middle! Can you see the waterfall and the glowing fortress?
lines.e0e680f0: The temple of Poseidon, high on a cliff above the sea. Watch the sun go down over the islands!
lines.e3e28a4c: A giant ink whirlpool spins round the board, then snaps shut in a burst of stars!
lines.e4688067: No frame at all, nice and simple.
lines.e4b5ad12: Warm amber numbers, like the glowing tubes in very old clocks.
lines.e6c24341: Zap! A crackling bolt follows every move.
lines.e6d99f4a: Deep rosewood and honey squares, framed in real gold leaf. It glows when the lights are low.
lines.e7d53482: Two checks done. Can your knight give the third?
lines.e80e1d85: A cool wisp of mint curls up behind every move, light as a breeze.
lines.e86f9ca5: See the glowing squares? d4, e4, d5 and e5. One step onto any of them wins the game at once.
lines.e8817d57: A gold chronograph with a cream face, like a fancy watch.
lines.e9fc0e72: Did you know ruby chocolate is real? It's pink, and it comes from special cocoa beans. Here it faces the darkest chocolate, glossy and smooth.
lines.ea7f1b90: Sakura Lacquer is pink like cherry blossoms in spring. It comes with the Tokyo Sky Garden and the Robot Squad.
lines.eb9e4770: Now it's your turn! Move a piece on the board, to answer.
lines.ec29a573: Marcus the wolf, from Ancient Rome. Bold and loyal.
lines.ed2af8cd: Ivy the giraffe, who always sees the whole board.
lines.edded2c7: The very top of the Burj Khalifa, the tallest building in the world. We're above the clouds!
lines.ee7c9ab9: Rook endings are tricky, but I know two magic positions!
lines.ef1bc599: Tick, tock! Let's make friends with the clock.
lines.f1141ef1: Twinkle, twinkle! Stars sprinkle behind every move.
lines.f25a2b0f: Grey mountain stone in a frame of fitted blocks, just like the walls the Inca built.
lines.f35f2f7f: Tap every point this elephant can reach.
lines.f3d398f0: Blue grey and white marble, in a frame of kingwood, like the grand houses of Paris.
lines.f3d6ac78: Warm travertine and grey marble, framed in purple porphyry and bronze. The stones of ancient Rome.
lines.f3daaa8b: Rooks love open roads, and bishops love open skies!
lines.f49f5071: Light oak and dark oak, cut by hand. Runes are carved all round the frame, like on a Viking hall.
lines.f5c9afb5: Walnut and Maple is a proper wooden board, with a gold line round the edge. Warm, simple and beautiful.
lines.f5ed78d1: A golden fireworks show for the harvest festival. A win worth cheering for!
lines.f7b3f626: Bramble the beaver, a busy builder who loves a plan.
lines.f8e24bbb: Checkmate in one move. Your general can help!
lines.f908e93a: Come under the sea! Coral Kingdom is carved in mother of pearl, with merfolk, an octopus, a seahorse and a coral castle. Their tails shimmer like fish scales.
lines.fa348fd7: The horse moves like a knight: one step along a line, then one on a slant. But a piece right next to it blocks that way. See how the soldier below stops two moves?
lines.fa4eb334: Take your time. If you're stuck, tap Hint, and I'll show you a good idea.
lines.fb087742: You have given two checks. Give the third and win.
lines.fb1af3a2: Nice work! You know how the pieces move, so we'll start with check and checkmate.
lines.fb6287a0: Long ago in India, chess had another name: chaturanga. It means the four parts of an army. Let's play it the old way!
lines.fc61c09c: A bright silver ring. You're really going places!
lines.fce7abc5: Your opponent has just moved. Find the best move, then keep going.
lines.fcf26250: Capture Black's last piece, and leave the king all alone.
lines.fd0b001c: The game is over, and you lost. What is a kind thing to say?
lines.fdacfb0a: Milk and Dark is as shiny as a brand new chocolate bar. Creamy milk chocolate on one side, rich dark on the other. It's the top prize of the Cocoa Harvest.
lines.fdbe8c04: These squares are the colours of a ripe cacao pod and its beans. That's where chocolate comes from!
lines.fe13f9e5: A crown of golden wheat, for a harvest king or queen.
lines.feafc929: Jade and Onyx is calm and cool. Pale green jade, loved in China for thousands of years, against smooth black onyx. It's a quiet set for a clever player.
lines.ff49e313: Under attack? Sometimes the best answer is a bigger attack!
lines.ffcf61ea: Close your eyes... just kidding! Let's train your chess memory.
lines.ffeec966: Boing! The knight is the only piece that jumps. Watch it hop!
